item.title: Grant Street reopen after roof collapse
item.description: BUFFALO, N.Y. (WIVB) -- A portion of Grant Street near Military Road is back open Friday night after a chunk of bricks fell off the facade of a building there. The Buffalo Fire Department said no injuries were sustained. The area was blocked off temporarily while crews worked to clean up the mess.

item.description: BUFFALO, N.Y.
